vt_operational_readiness_meta.interpretation: bounded operational readiness score in [0,1], not a literal realized service-success probability
vt_operational_readiness_meta.construction: aircraft-weighted geometric aggregation for ops combined with weighted geometric integration of energy and ops, with floor clipping
vt_operational_readiness_meta.ops_blend_component: ops = aircraft^w * departure^(1-w), then readiness = energy^a * ops^(1-a)
